title: amaysim 28-Day 15GB Prepaid SIM $10 (Was $30) Express Delivered @ amaysim
body:
Deal: amaysim 28-Day 15GB Prepaid SIM $10 (Was $30) Express Delivered @ amaysim

[brokenglish] Been burned before (porting mishaps). Almost lost my main number.
[Lone star] @brokenglish: Ok, this is my experience. I'm a "Sim slutter". I managed 6 Sims (my family members). Only problem I have with Lebara is that I have to call up everytime to activate/port over to them. Online it would tell me that my number already exists on their network. Porting back and forth with Lebara takes only about 30mins after all setup has been done. With Lyca, I've just (this month) trying them out. Porting 3 numbers over to Lyca took also about 30mins. 1 number was from Coles Mobile over to Lyca. 2 other numbers was from Lebara over to Lyca. Will be interesting to see if it will as easy to port out soon.
[scrimshaw] https://www.ozbargain.com.au/deals/lycamobile.com.au
Every deal posted for Lycamobile in 2026 has at least 2 negative votes and a long running one has 14 negative votes , so it's worth nothing Lycamobile has quite the number of complaints (all mostly related to billing and porting)
The Lycamobile forum https://www.ozbargain.com.au/forum/lycamobile.com.au also has some feedback regarding the porting process.
[OnlyHans] Also in this week's Coles catalogue:-
Dodo $23 SIM Credit Pack - $8
Coles Mobile $30 Prepaid SIM (35GB) - $11
Coles Mobile $35 Prepaid SIM (45GB) - $12
Dodo $23 credit can be used towards their $15/mth 40GB or $20/mth 80GB plans . Meaning you could get two 40GB months for a net outlay of $8+7, or two 80GB months for a net outlay of $8+17.
[Lone star] Wow. I didnt think abou that before. Thanks, I'll try out soon.
[brokenglish] Goddamn, learnt something new today!
Idk why I thought Dodo uses Voda (actually Optus).
Took me a while to understand this, at this time of day.
So with $8, you get Dodo $23 credit:
1st month: $23 credit minus $15 plan = $8 credit remaining | total spending: $8 ($8/month)
2nd month: $8 credit minus $15 plan = fork out $7 | total spending: $15 ($7.5/month)
3rd month: $0 credit minus $15 plan = fork out $15 | total spending $30 ($10/month)
Thanks for sharing, @OnlyHans! Dodo is now in my rotation!
(Note to others that Dodo is a postpaid plan, they'll do a "soft" credit check)
[OnlyHans] You got it. In effect it works out like a $15 discount on the price over 2 months. And that's decent value for SIM sluts, including 50GB bonus data on activation.
Note - if wanting to cancel, log into your account in browser (not app) and there is a cancel service option near the top centre of the screen . (No need to do this if porting out.)
[DigitalJeezus] same goes for p much all Optus MVNOs atp lol. I get much better service with Boost (and Telstra when they run offers).
I've used Optus, Coles and Amaysim in the past 90 days and network range and speed has been pretty underwhelming and borderline trash for the most part.
[SoylentGreen] Can amaysim account be activated without Sim in phone, for a future amaysim phone purchase.
[brokenglish] Not that I know of.
To be able to “login”, you must have had an account in the past, or activate a new number.
[Edge12] Always a good idea to try and get Officeworks to price beat the offers from Coles, Woolworths or sim networks' websites especially on Lebara sim card as they don't have cashback offers on Shopback or Topcashback. I have had some success but they verify that the data allowance has to be exact same on what Officeworks sim cards are offering.
Additionally you could use gift card that you've bought on 10% discount at Coles and Woolies for payment. Plus the 5x flubuys points if you're OnePass member.
